title: Palacio San José, Entre Ríos
geometryBasis: Mapped main residence enclosure and the two court voids, with the axial visitor gallery and gates, two square towers, pale Tuscan arches and pink stucco fixed by four exact same-day photographs.
sectionBasis: The main approach is the terrain-contact datum. Estimated terrace, gallery and courtyard surfaces bridge the original relief with shallow thresholds, while the two flanking towers rise above the one-story gallery.
limitations: January 2010 exterior of the main residence, including both open courtyards. The detached chapel, gardens, lake, ancillary buildings and interiors are outside the model.
Arcade bay spacing, precise roof slopes and balcony detailing, rear elevations and individual thresholds are approximate. The photographs establish exterior character and original architecture.
Terrain samples remain unchanged. The map frame and building registration are an approximate visualization.
